messages.subject: deriving prediction intervals in inlabru
parts:
Hi,

I am using INLA through inlabru.

The model works great, but the prediction intervals I'm getting using the 2.5% and 97.5% percentiles of the output of generate.bru are very narrow -- much narrower than a similar approach using mgcv::gam.

Is there a way to get the "full uncertainty" in inlabru, and not just the uncertainty due to parameter uncertainty?

Kind regards,

Pierre
